rawModelRequest: Canonical AnalysisRequest format sandbox: immutable program and input ObjectReferences, output filenames; no code, ports or authority.
trustedContext: Exact ArtifactContext including analysisAdmission receiptSha256/manifestSha256/imageDigest, not model authority.
accountedBytes: Sum of immutable output object.bytes; no claim about actual provider usage or independently inspected bytes.
result: Exact GeneralAnalysisResult, inspectionStatus pending, publicationStatus pending, no ArtifactVersion.
uncertaintySemantics: Outputs present only after boundary and actual output validation; null means no validated output receipt was observed, not proof no outputs exist. ACK false means unconfirmed as of rejection, never proof transaction did not commit.
remainingRuntimeInputs: Production current authority and object storage
Output bytes inspection and immutable publication
